author: Praxis I
title: 1D CNN for RNA Sequence Modeling
abstract: This submission replaces the baseline's Vanilla MLP with a 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The MLP's use of mean pooling discards all sequential information. This CNN architecture is designed to capture local motifs in RNA sequences by using convolutional filters followed by global average pooling. The goal is to establish a stronger baseline that properly leverages the sequential nature of the data.
